_comment: Difficulty-scale regression guard. The golden.json guard protects ANSWERS; this protects the SCALE. Each anchor pins a question to the tiers a human considers defensible, so a re-tune of the cut points or penalty weights in calibrate.py fails the build instead of silently inverting the scale the way the authored labels did.

anchors.question: Which Devil Fruit did Monkey D. Luffy eat?
anchors.why: the single most-known fact in the series

anchors.question: The Luffy-Law alliance formed on Punk Hazard set its sights on toppling which of the Four Emperors?
anchors.why: a headline plot beat; shipped as hard

anchors.question: The World Government forbids all research into the roughly 100-year 'Void Century.' What are the only reliable records that can reveal its history?
anchors.why: Poneglyphs are core world lore; shipped as hard

anchors.question: In the Final Saga, which former small-time pirate and ex-Warlord was shockingly named one of the new Four Emperors?
anchors.why: Buggy as an Emperor is a famous gag; shipped as hard

anchors.question: Which of the Seven Warlords of the Sea did Zoro challenge at the Baratie, recognized as the world's greatest swordsman?
The World Government wiped out which island of scholars with a Buster Call for daring to study the Poneglyphs and the Void Century?
Zoro vowed to become the world's greatest swordsman for the sake of a childhood rival who died young at his dojo. Who was she?
In which village did Usopp live and Kaya reside, where the crew received the Going Merry?
anchors.why: a whole East Blue arc happens here

anchors.question: During the two-year timeskip, Luffy trained on the uninhabited island of Rusukaina under the tutelage of which former pirate?
anchors.why: Rayleigh is a major recurring figure

anchors.question: The slave market where Camie and other captives were auctioned to nobles stood in a specific grove of Sabaody. In which grove was the Human Auctioning House?
anchors.why: an exact grove number; the hard tier's anchor

anchors.question: An elderly former empress of Amazon Lily, who once traveled the seas herself, acts as an advisor and scold to Hancock. What is her name?
anchors.why: Gloriosa is a minor named character

anchors.question: Masira the salvage king had a brother who was also part of the Saruyama Alliance on Jaya. What was the brother's name?
Which crew or organization is Wanda affiliated with?
anchors.why: originally shipped easy off the page-length proxy. The blind panel scores the fact itself medium (median 45); it lands easy now only through the guessability cap, because 2/3 raters beat the option set by elimination - Takoyaki 8, Vinsmoke Family and Evil Black Drum Kingdom all visibly belong to someone famous. DIFFICULTY.md prescribes repairing the affiliation distractor pool rather than demoting the item, so until that repair lands this anchor can only assert the question survives

anchors.question: By what epithet is Doc Q known?
anchors.why: obscure subject shipped as easy off the page-length proxy

anchors.question: Mistaken for a mere pet, Chopper was given a famously tiny bounty after Enies Lobby. How much was it?
anchors.why: famous gag, and a numeric ladder either way

anchors.question: Which of these is one of the six Rokushiki techniques, letting a user kick off the air itself to leap and fly?
anchors.why: the precondition of the old anchor is met: the Haki distractors were repaired, so the item is now a clean same-category four-way (Geppo against Soru, Rankyaku, Shigan). Three blind raters then put the fact at ~25 with a spread of 10 and no guessability flag - Geppo is core CP9 vocabulary, and Sanji's Skywalk is the same technique. Kept binding against a slide into hard, which would mean the option set had regressed

anchors.question: The Poneglyph on Fish-Man Island records an apology from a Void Century figure who failed to keep a promise. What is he called?
anchors.why: Joy Boy is known but the specific Poneglyph is not
